captions.detailed: This object is a ceiling-mounted cassette air conditioning unit panel, commonly used in commercial interior HVAC systems. It features a square, flat light-gray outer trim with rounded corners, a central square intake grille with horizontal slats, and four rectangular air discharge flaps situated along each of the four outer edges. The four flaps are designed to rotate on horizontal hinges to control airflow direction, while a small rectangular inspection indicator is integrated into one corner of the trim ring.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a commercial cassette air conditioning ceiling panel. The model should include a square outer frame with rounded corners, a central slatted intake grille, and four rectangular directional air flaps along each edge that can rotate on horizontal revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct the main panel frame using a flat, square Box with rounded vertical edges, then subtract a central square opening. Create the central intake grille by repeating thin rectangular slats inside the opening. Model the four air discharge flaps as individual thin rectangular boxes positioned along each of the four inner edges of the frame. Define revolute joints for each of the four flaps using horizontal rotation axes aligned with their respective edges.
